title: Guided tour in Alcazar
text:
The waiting line for the Alcazar in Seville was probably as long as 3 to 4 hours. A guy was selling tickets for a guided tour for €36, that was starting half an hour later, and since we only had one day, we decided to go for it.

The tour was delayed somewhat half an hour, which wasn't a problem for us, since we wanted to go to a nearby roof terrace for a drink anyway.

With the guided tour, we could skip the queue and got inside in about 15 minutes. Our guide, Jorge, is from Seville and his ancestors go back a long time in Seville's history. He told us a lot of interesting details about the A
author: Gert_DS

title: Wonderful tour with Susana
text: Susana gave us an excellent walking tour of Seville including the Alcazar. We enjoyed the tour so much we asked her to do a second tour the following day to include the old Jewish quarter. I holy recommend her. Her fund of knowledge is great and her presentation excellent.
author: Judith S

title: Excellent guide and therefore... excellent visit
text: We had Jorge as a guide for a whole family to discover the joys of the Alcazar as well as those of the cathedral the next day... This guide is just a love, it explains wonderfully and passionately the history of Seville through these magnificent "buildings".
author: Muska B
